interventions.role: replace both learned-layer map fields with identity maps while retaining learned update and classifier weights
apply one fixed non-identity node permutation to each layer's learned maps, shared across participants for that permutation
replace each learned layer with fixed random O(2) node-by-bundle maps, shared across participants for that permutation
rewire each participant graph by deterministic double-edge swaps while preserving the exact binary degree sequence
permute encoded node rows and adjacency consistently; must preserve logits and permutation-invariant diagnostics

randomization.random_map_parameterization: uniform angles with the Study 1 rotation/reflection bundle split

endpoints.primary: equal-site mean change in held-out balanced accuracy relative to the same accepted checkpoint without intervention
secondary: common-frame normalized effective-rank change at layer 2
endpoints.aggregation: average participants within checkpoint, then five model seeds within site-density; paired equal-site inference is primary
endpoints.random_family_summary: average the 100 stored permutation estimates within site-density before site-level inference
endpoints.uncertainty: 10000 paired site bootstrap resamples with exact paired sign-flip tests for named primary contrasts
endpoints.multiplicity: Holm correction across the four intervention-family primary contrasts

promotion_gate.smoke_scope: all four densities, all five accepted final seeds, all interventions, and all 100 permutations
promotion_gate.results_embargo: No predictive or representation values may be displayed before the smoke artifact passes its score-blind audit.
full_run_requires: all archived predictions reproduced within tolerance
score-blind smoke audit passes with zero warnings
projected full runtime with 30 percent contingency leaves at least 12 hours for audit, analysis, and paper QA
SNS start and terminal notifications are configured

interpretation_rules: Sensitivity to maps shows computational use of those maps, not biological geometry.
Insensitivity to maps does not prove that geometric structure is absent from brains.
Topology sensitivity shows dependence on the constructed graph, not anatomy or causal flow.
Prediction and representation changes may be described as co-occurring, not causal mediation.
